name: Player Ranks
description: Shows each connected player's external rating in Live Status. Pick the sources per instance on its Ranks tab: qlstats, Slipgate and x76. qlstats and Slipgate connection details are set once for the installation; x76 is configured per instance. Every enabled source is fetched in one request and stacked in a single Rank column. Needs QLSM with ui_api 4 or newer.

global.label: qlstats: on by default
global.description: Applies to instances whose Ranks tab has not been saved yet. A saved Ranks tab decides for itself.

global.label: qlstats: rating path
global.description: The API path ratings are fetched from. Use the same value as qlx_balanceApi on your servers, e.g. elo, elo_b or elo/bn, so Live Status matches !elo. Blank means elo.

global.label: Slipgate: on by default
global.description: Applies to instances whose Ranks tab has not been saved yet. A saved Ranks tab decides for itself.

global.label: Slipgate: API key / token
global.description: Optional -- with a key, one bulk request covers the whole roster; without one, one public request per player.

global.label: x76: API key (default)
global.description: Used by instances that leave their own key blank. x76 returns nothing without a key, on any instance.

instance.label: internal: has this instance's Ranks tab ever been saved
internal: were the per-instance source checkboxes ever saved
x76: API key override
instance.description: Blank falls back to the installation-wide default set on the Addons page.

instance_ranks.description: Tick the rating sources this instance shows in Live Status. qlstats and Slipgate use the connection details from Settings -> Addons -> Player Ranks; until this tab is saved they follow the defaults set there. x76 is configured here. If server.cfg already carries qlx_rankedServiceUrl, the first load suggests matching x76 values -- nothing is written until you hit Save.

fields.label: x76: Base URL
fields.description: Required when x76 is ticked -- no default.

fields.label: x76: API key override
fields.description: Blank uses the installation-wide default from Settings. x76 returns nothing without a key.

fields.label: x76: pool
fields.description: Required when x76 is ticked. The exact pool name the service was configured with.

fields.label: x76: show
fields.description: A player with no rank label yet still shows the score.

global_sources.description: Connection details for qlstats and Slipgate, and whether each is on by default. Which sources an instance actually shows is chosen on that instance's own Ranks tab; the defaults here apply only until that tab is saved. x76 is configured per instance.
